snippet.title: Catacomb3D CD32 preview
snippet.description:
We will sonn release a new game for the CD32 and indieGO!.
Catacomb 3D
The game uses the Akiko chip, has joypad controls and can use the internal storage for saving. There is still a way to go : )
Stay tuned
